rationale: The fade thesis has decayed rather than been formally invalidated: five consecutive up 1m closes have pushed price back above the 9-EMA, the risk-off tailwind has halved (SPY -0.64%→-0.32%, VIXY +2.14%→+1.13%), and with MFE and MAE nearly symmetric the trade has shown no follow-through in 27 minutes and is now drifting toward the 33.75 VWAP that anchors the invalidation. Closing into a 3-bp spread costs roughly $25 and preserves the remaining $488.80 loss budget plus the option to re-short on a VWAP rejection or a break of the 33.35 low. Flipping long is not justified — it would mean buying mid-range, below VWAP, on shrinking lunchtime volume, which is weaker evidence than simply being flat.
